overlay_template:
base_config: <OMNI_REPO>/vllm_omni/deploy/qwen3_omni_moe_mrv2.yaml
cuda_mps: false
connectors:
  connector_of_shared_memory:
    extra:
      code_predictor_prefix_graphs: true
      code_predictor_kv_cache: false
      code_predictor_short_kv: false
      code_predictor_fused_sampling: false
      codec_cudnn_benchmark: true
control: MRv2 base with campaign eager-MTP capability adapter; original two-GPU placement (Thinker logical0, Talker and Code2Wav logical1), MPS off. Inherits MRv2 first-audio, chunk ramp, fused snake and codec graph batching. Incremental KV, short-KV and fused sampling explicitly disabled.
hypothesis: Shorter predictor prefix re-prefill reduces padded transformer work; scoped cuDNN algorithm search may reduce codec convolution cost. Combined candidate cannot establish an isolated feature gain.

sources.scope: Campaign adapter and parity tests; reused staging attributed separately in source-attribution.md

implementation_review: common/qwen3_code_predictor.py:788-814: prefix re-prefill enabled on CUDA independently of wrapper-owned graph flag; KV and fused sampling remain separate options.
qwen3_omni/qwen3_omni_moe_code_predictor_mtp.py:21: CUDA MRv2 disables inner predictor graphs; shorter compiled forwards are captured by the outer Talker MTP graph.

common/qwen3_code_predictor.py:1046-1109,1144-1173,1298-1325: all prefixes 2..num_groups warmed across execution buckets by default; smallest available covering prefix selected; missing prefix falls back to full length.

qwen3_omni/qwen3_omni_code2wav.py:385-402: benchmark algorithm search limited to10, CUDA eager path only; context restores deterministic/TF32 policy and prior flags; captured replay uses selected kernels.
startup_risk: Default all-prefix warmup scales as execution batch buckets times (num_groups-1) prefixes, each warmed twice. This campaign has16 codebooks: prefixes2..16 are15 lengths;11 outer batch buckets imply approximately165 shape specializations before outer capture. Dynamo cache limit is raised accordingly. Expect materially more startup compilation/cache memory than full-length re-prefill. No startup time or memory estimate is measured.
quality: Native sampler and model preserved, but shorter matrix shapes and cuDNN algorithm selection may change floating-point rounding and generated codes/audio. Require unchanged protocol-v5 WER gate before promotion; no claim of bitwise parity or quality equivalence.

existing_tests.prefix: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty: pytest tests/model_executor/models/qwen3_tts/test_code_predictor_dtype.py -k prefix:5 passed,51 deselected. Includes TestCodePredictorWrapperConfig prefix configuration/helpers and three prefixed-weight loading cases. These do not establish full-model numerical parity.
existing_tests.codec: tests/model_executor/models/qwen3_omni/test_qwen3_omni_code2wav_cudnn.py:62,98,119 cover dtype parity with graphs, replay flag restoration and exception restoration; CUDA tests inspected only, not run for this preparation

gates: No gate changes. Screening is separate from full conditioning/repeated paired formal trials under protocol-v5; no measured gain or promotion.
